subject: MATHEMATICS
applicability_conditions: learner must predict the quadrant of a point after a sign change of one or both coordinates
use when quadrant answers are recalled by number rather than derived from coordinate signs
anchor: Quadrant membership is decided by the ordered pair of signs, so changing the sign of a coordinate reflects the point across the corresponding axis.
ordinary_language_bridge: Read the point as 'sign of x, sign of y' first; the quadrant name follows from that pair, not from memory.
reconstruction_route: record the sign of each coordinate of the given point
apply the stated sign transformation to the correct coordinate
name the quadrant that the new sign pair defines
locate the transformed point on axes to confirm the reflection

minimal_contrast.shared_structure: the same starting point and the same magnitude of coordinates
minimal_contrast.prediction_prompt: Across which axis does this sign change reflect the point?
minimal_contrast.decisive_feature: the negated coordinate names the axis of reflection

misconception_discriminator.candidate_wrong_model: quadrants advance in order whenever any sign changes
misconception_discriminator.probe: ask for the quadrant after negating only the second coordinate, with the sign pair stated
misconception_discriminator.decisive_response: learner derives the quadrant from the new sign pair rather than counting quadrants

repair_route: rebuild the sign pair for the original point
apply the transformation to one coordinate only
re-derive the quadrant from the resulting sign pair
retry with the other coordinate negated
verification_method: plot the original and transformed points and confirm the reflection axis
confirm the reported quadrant matches the derived sign pair
known_limitations: does not address points lying on an axis, which belong to no quadrant
does not cover rotations or non-sign transformations
